text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Universe! Are you in the middle of 
cooking, desu ka? There are lots of 
delicious-looking sweets, desu!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. "EPRM" of handmade "SWTS". A 
"Present".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That's right... "REQU" for "Tasting". "<chrname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure it's okay for us? Well 
then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What an exceedingly strange flavor... I 
can feel the vastness of the cosmos...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Universe? How much cooking do you 
usually...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Eclipse". ..."Hardly ever", indeed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Friends
text_block_list.text: I see, desu! I see... I see!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Status: Negative. However, Neo Universe 
will "Handmake".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Transmission" of "Signal". ...This is 
"Polaris". "Absolute".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You have your reasons, don't you. ...In 
that case, shall we try making it 
together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When in trouble, intuition is key, desu! 
Go with instinct!
(BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's try following the recipe exactly, 
shall we? That's definitely for the best.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So hard!? My tooth!? My teeeeeth!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-It's gotten completely late, hasn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Everyone to "Return Module". Neo Universe 
will "CNT".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "Signal" to "Transmit" is 100%. 
—Therefore, "Give Up" is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Universe...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Guh... If it has come to this! Grant me 
your aid, Shiraoki-sama!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Honnyaka honnyaka funnyaka heeeey!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It has arrived! According to 
Shiraoki-sama, —'Gaze upon its true form!' 
is the word!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Gaze upon its true form...? Um... That's 
advice for cooking, right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
! Affirmative. True form... That is 
"element".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Egg yolk lecithin is the "Key" to "AFTN". 
Water and fats, "DCL" [ΔG] towards 
harmony. Prescribing "Emulsion" following 
structural laws.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Maintain meringue's [Aeration Rate ω]. 
Powders define "Stability" as "STBL". 
"Terminal Velocity" converges to zero...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Following [CGL], with the [Ideal Gas Law], 
[Volume V] is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Universe has started writing 
incantations, yo!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-Is she trying to understand the recipe 
chemically...? There are so many numbers 
and symbols...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —"Analysis Complete".

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Tiramisu!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hardness is also "JYVE". Teeth are "Safe".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It's very delicious! The bitterness 
of the coffee and sweetness of the cream 
are exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As expected of Shiraoki-sama! And of 
you, Universe-san! This is practically 
already complete, isn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Negative". This is... still "Phase B".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Following the "Recipe" is not enough... 
Neo Universe wants to convey "Precious".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Sweetness", "Bitterness", "Hardness", 
"Ratio". Imbuing the "Signal" into all of 
them.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Words are "LOST". But because I "Want to 
Convey".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all three of you, I found the 
"Space Sign".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If it's Universe, you can definitely do 
it, desu! You can do it! desu!

One day, I spotted Neo Universe spreading 
out recipe books and specialized chemistry 
texts.
choice_data_list:
...Could it be you're having trouble 
again?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Voyage is "Smooth".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Remaining until "Phase E". ...Will do a 
lot of "Giving My Best".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Space Sign" is 'Gaze upon its true form'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Therefore, this "ACTI" is "Safe". "NPB".
